verdict.rationale: Vercel offers infrastructure for building and connecting AI agents (AI Gateway, agent tool creation, sandboxed execution, and letting 'AI agents deploy a project and let a human take over'), suggesting some agentic capability tied to deployments. However, there's no clear evidence of a built-in conversational AI assistant inside the Vercel product itself that users delegate general tasks to—these are developer-facing building blocks rather than a native assistant experience.
